faqIntro: What to know before choosing your license.
faqDeliveryQuestion: When will I receive my key and installers?
faqDeliveryAnswer: Once payment is confirmed, your activation key and available downloads will appear in your HYRO library.
faqRedownloadQuestion: Can I download the installers again?
faqRedownloadAnswer: Yes. If you lose the files, sign in and download them again from My library.
faqPlatformsQuestion: Does HYRO work on Windows and macOS?
faqPlatformsAnswer: Yes. HYRO Visuals is available for Windows and macOS.
faqLicenseQuestion: How many devices can I use with a Personal license?
faqLicenseAnswer: A Personal license includes one activation key for using HYRO on one device at a time.
faqSubscriptionAnswer: No. You buy the Personal license once, and future updates are included.
faqTeamsQuestion: Can I buy the Teams license now?
faqTeamsAnswer: Not yet. The Teams option is prepared for three independent keys and will become available when its payment plan is connected.
faqPaymentAnswer: Payment is completed in a secure form. Before confirming, you can see the methods available for your device and region.
